screen_specifications.screen_1_overview: Primary control-room HMI featuring dynamic microgrid energy flow diagram, top telemetry ribbon, horizon power stack area chart, and core KPIs.
screen_specifications.screen_2_energy_flow: SCADA Single-Line Diagram showing Microgrid AC / Energy Bus, inverter/generator SCADA symbol nodes, battery SOC gauge, and directional power flow indicators.
screen_specifications.screen_3_forecasts: 24h forecast horizon visualization displaying Stage81ForecastEngine irradiance (W/m2), 37-feature model metadata card, PV engineering conversion mapping, and synthetic demand curve.
screen_specifications.screen_4_optimization_mpc: SciPy MILP decision view showing dynamic MPC step k/N, solve time (ms), objective value, and 24-step DispatchPlan table with H1 execution highlight.
screen_specifications.screen_5_digital_twin: Simulated station state progression showing battery SOC trajectory (%), cumulative diesel fuel/energy, and step k -> k+1 state transition monitor.
screen_specifications.screen_6_scenarios: Scenario selector supporting authorized synthetic scenarios S1 Normal, S2 Low Solar, S4 High Demand, S5 High Renewable, S6 Low Battery, and S7 Governed Infeasibility.
screen_specifications.screen_7_alarms: Industrial alarm table displaying severity (GOVERNED_DEGRADED / CRITICAL), source, and D4-C1 zero-dispatch fault containment rules.
screen_specifications.screen_8_analytics: Post-hoc EMS metrics summary showing 85.92L fuel consumed, 84.82% renewable utilization, 213.02 kWh battery throughput, and scoped 0 kWh unmet load statement.

objective_value.context: SciPy MILP cost objective (1e9 on fault)
